A small restaurant with incredible food
Nov 2023 • Family
We all came to this restaurant by reading reviews online. When we went there, there was a restaurant at the door. The restaurant looked old, so I really wanted to turn around and leave. Once I came, I took it easy and didn't want to go back. It’s time to look around for food elsewhere. We were all overjoyed with their food service. We ordered a lot of food, and the staff would talk to us and call us after we finished eating. It was so kind.
We ordered nacho, carbonara, lasagna, chicken nugget, etc., and everything was delicious. The lasagna was a little worse, and the noodles were rotten, but they were all delicious. There were six of us. They all cost about HK$250. Very recommended shop
